scope: Training-only numerical loss/gradient diagnostic on frozen fitted heads; no optimizer updates or wake inference.
hypothesis: The shared intent-phone fit stalls and produces incomplete greedy strings. Before attributing this to representation or fitting budget, compare actual compiled TensorFlow CTC loss and logit gradient against an independent stable float64 forward/backward recurrence. Extreme synthetic logits check sensitivity outside ordinary scales.
selection: First3 unique original training crops per engine and intent class, in original deduplicated bank order. No score-based selection; exactly60 crops. Both full-fit checkpoints use the same original crops.
math: Independent NumPy float64 expanded-state forward/backward, explicit skip/repeat rules, stable logaddexp recurrence and per-token posterior occupancy derivative p-posterior. Compared with the compiled TensorFlow2.21 float32 CTC operation actually used for training. Summed per-example losses expose gradients without extra token/batch normalization; training normalization is a constant rescaling. Retain logits, labels, lengths and both losses/gradients for all actual/synthetic cases.

covers: Exhaustive all paths length5 for repeated and distinct labels
Posterior occupancy gradient versus exact path enumeration
Large-logit finite-difference derivatives and per-frame logit-shift invariance

interpretation: Report absolute/relative loss and gradient differences, ranges and actual zeros where reference magnitude exceeds.001. No fitted tolerance, model-quality gate or automatic training follows. Absence of a large numerical discrepancy does not prove a unique cause for the fit failure. TF dense CTC float64 gradient failed in a preliminary smoke with an internal float/double Mul type mismatch; the actual training path is float32, which is the audited path.
limits: Optimization-seen cached features and frozen full-fit checkpoints only; no training, hyperparameter choice, development/final inference, new labels, source waveform access, playback, microphone capture, board/OTA or audio speed/producer change. Numerical agreement is not recognition, pronunciation, latency, P4 resource or call-stability proof.
